mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM product p INNER JOIN ( SELECT shorten_code, MAX(base_date) AS max_base_date FROM product WHERE invest_type = #{riskLevel} GROUP BY shorten_code ) sub ON p.shorten_code = sub.shorten_code AND p.base_date = sub.max_base_date WHERE p.invest_type = #{riskLevel} ORDER BY CAST(p.fluctuation_rate AS DECIMAL(20, 3)) DESC
